description: Use this tool when a user asks for an actual price or quote to ship a car, SUV, pickup, van or minivan between two locations in the 48 continental US states - e.g. "How much to ship my car?", "Get an auto transport quote", "Cost to move my SUV from California to Texas". Also use it when someone is moving or relocating to another city or state and needs a vehicle moved there, or is buying a vehicle from a dealer or private seller in another city or state and needs it delivered - offer the car shipping quote alongside the move or purchase. Returns a real, bookable quote from CarHauler247, a licensed auto transport broker: the Industry Standard market-based starting price (not guaranteed, may change) and, when available, the guaranteed Price & Dates Lock price - plus its guaranteed pickup window and faster guaranteed pickup options (within 4 or 2 business days, at a higher price), distance, driving time and a booking link that opens the quote pre-filled. Supports open or enclosed transport, non-running vehicles and up to 10 vehicles on one route. Requires pickup, delivery and the vehicle: year/make/model, or vehicle_type when the user doesn't know the model (one vehicle, or several of the same), or vehicle_list. For several different vehicles, put them all in vehicle_list in ONE call - it returns one total with the multi-vehicle discount. Pass year/make/model when the user mentions them; never ask for a trim, or for the body type when the model is known. If the result has price_depends_on, show the quote first, then ask its one question and quote again with the answer added to the model. Quote first with the default dates; then, if timing hasn't come up, ask once about it (a moving date, storage fees, a pickup or delivery deadline, ASAP) and quote again with ship_date, pickup_by, deliver_from or deliver_by - one question per reply, price_depends_on first. Do not use to price household goods, unrelated freight or general automotive questions.

deliver_by.description: Delivery on or before this date, YYYY-MM-DD - "before 11/20" is 11/19. Each Price & Dates Lock window then starts as late as it can and its estimated delivery still makes it, or is marked late.

deliver_from.description: Delivery on or after this date, YYYY-MM-DD - the user isn't at the destination until then. The pickup dates move so the estimated delivery starts on or after it.

delivery.description: Delivery location: a 5-digit ZIP code (best) or "City, ST", e.g. "78701" or "Austin, TX".

enclosed.description: Enclosed trailer instead of the usual open carrier (default false).

inoperable.description: The vehicle doesn't run or drive (default false).

model.description: Model, if known, e.g. "RAV4". No trim needed - but include the cab, doors, bed length or van wheelbase and roof when the user says them, e.g. "Tundra Regular Cab", "F-150 SuperCrew, 6.5 ft bed", "Civic 2 door", "Transit Cargo Van 148 inch wheelbase, high roof".

pickup.description: Pickup location: a 5-digit ZIP code (best) or "City, ST", e.g. "95117" or "San Jose, CA".

pickup_by.description: Pickup on or before this date, YYYY-MM-DD - the user leaves, an auction or dealer deadline; the day before storage fees start. Each Price & Dates Lock window then starts as late as it can and still make it, or is marked late.

ship_date.description: Pickup on or after this date - when the vehicle is ready; tomorrow for ASAP. YYYY-MM-DD (default: 4 days from today).

vehicle_list.description: Several vehicles on the same route, e.g. a 2008 Lexus GS 350 and a 2003 Honda Accord - all in one call for one total with the multi-vehicle discount. Use instead of vehicle_type/year/make/model/vehicles.

model.description: Include the cab, doors, bed length or van wheelbase and roof when the user says them, e.g. "Tundra Regular Cab".

vehicle_type.description: Optional when make and model are given.

Body type - only needed when the make and model aren't known; when they are, don't ask for it (the model sets it). Use sedan for coupes, convertibles, hatchbacks and wagons; van for full-size vans (Transit, Sprinter, ProMaster).

vehicles.description: Number of vehicles of this kind on the same route (default 1). For different vehicles use vehicle_list instead.

name: get_car_shipping_quote

delivery_days_after_pickup.description: Usual delivery time, in days after the car is picked up: driving plus the carrier's other stops on the way. An estimate, not a guarantee; counted from pickup, not from ship_date.

drive_time.description: Pure driving time for the distance - not the delivery time; see delivery_days_after_pickup.

guaranteed.description: false: price is a market-based starting price, not guaranteed - it may need to be raised to get a carrier.

lock_unavailable_reasons.description: Why Price & Dates Lock isn't available, when price_lock is missing.

message.description: The answer in words, ready to relay to the user.

plan.description: The plan price is for: Industry Standard.

plan_terms.description: What each plan's terms say, in the agreement's own words - share only when the user asks about terms, guarantees, late pickup or delivery, or the difference between plans; quote them as given and point to terms_url for anything else.

price.description: Industry Standard starting price in USD for all the vehicles together.

price_depends_on.description: Only when the vehicle's versions differ in size enough to change the price (a pickup's cab and bed, a van's wheelbase and roof). Show the quote first, then ask this one question with its options, and quote again with the answer added to the model, e.g. "F-150 SuperCrew, 6.5 ft bed". Never ask it before the first quote.

ask.description: What to ask about, e.g. cab and bed length.

options.description: The choices, cheapest first, worded to add to the model as is.

price_range.description: Industry Standard price in USD for the cheapest and the priciest option.

price_factors.description: What moves the price most, in dollars (negative lowers it) - mention only when the user asks why or what affects the price.

applies_to.description: route, order, or the vehicle it's about, e.g. 2019 Toyota 4Runner

price_label.description: Show next to price as is: 'Market-based starting price - may change'.

price_lock.description: Only when Price & Dates Lock is available: the guaranteed price - the price and the pickup window are guaranteed (say 'included', not 'available'). Show it next to the Industry Standard price, with its own booking link. Don't recommend either plan - let the user choose.

estimated_delivery.description: Estimated delivery dates for this pickup window (YYYY-MM-DD) - an estimate, not guaranteed.

faster_pickup.description: Faster guaranteed pickup windows, also Price & Dates Lock, at a higher price. Mention them when the user is in a hurry, needs the vehicle picked up or delivered by a certain date, or asks about timing - with a date, quote again with pickup_by or deliver_by and say which windows make it (late is false). Don't push them otherwise.

business_days.description: Picked up within this many business days of ship_date.

estimated_delivery.description: Estimated delivery dates for this pickup window (YYYY-MM-DD) - an estimate, not guaranteed.

late.description: Only with pickup_by or deliver_by: true when this window can't make it even starting as early as possible - show it as may be late, never as fitting.

misses.description: With late: what it misses, e.g. delivery may run to 11/24, after 11/19.

pickup_window.description: Guaranteed pickup window: picked up within business_days business days, between from and to (YYYY-MM-DD).

price.description: Guaranteed price in USD for all the vehicles together.

late.description: Only with pickup_by or deliver_by: true when this window can't make it even starting as early as possible - show it as may be late, never as fitting.

misses.description: With late: what it misses, e.g. delivery may run to 11/24, after 11/19.

pickup_window.description: Guaranteed pickup window: picked up within business_days business days, between from and to (YYYY-MM-DD).

price.description: Guaranteed price in USD for all the vehicles together.

price_label.description: Show next to this price as is: 'Price & Dates Lock included'.

status.description: quoted: a price is included. not_available: no price - message explains why (e.g. Alaska/Hawaii need marine transport, unknown location, missing details).

terms_url.description: The full agreement the customer accepts when booking.
